Incoterms 2020

Incele Incoterms 2020 terms for lojistik profesyonelleri.

Diller

Ad Valorem

A Latin term meaning 'according to value,' used for duties, taxes, or charges calculated as a percentage of the declared value of goods in customs, insurance, or freight contracts.

Terimi gor

Aframax Tanker

A medium-sized crude oil or product tanker with a deadweight between 80,000 and 120,000 metric tons, optimized for maximum capacity within AFRA freight scale. Common in global seaborne oil trade.

Terimi gor

Alıcı Bildirimi

A formal alert sent by carrier or freight forwarder to the named consignee informing them that the cargo has arrived or is ready for pickup at a specified location.

Terimi gor

Anlık Yükleme

A one-time cargo movement arranged at current market rates without any long-term contract or commitment, typically used for urgent or irregular transport needs.

Terimi gor

Antrepo

A secured facility authorized by customs authorities where imported goods can be stored, manipulated, or undergo manufacturing operations without payment of duties and taxes until they are released for local consumption or re-export.

Terimi gor

ATA Karnesi

An international customs document permitting the temporary admission of goods (e.g., exhibition samples, professional equipment) without duties or taxes.

Terimi gor

Atanmış Terminal

A specific port terminal appointed by the carrier, shipper, or contract terms for loading or unloading cargo, subject to operational planning and contractual designation.

Terimi gor

Ağırlık Doğrulama

The certified process of confirming and documenting the gross weight of a packed container, as required by SOLAS and port authorities.

Terimi gor

Bayrak Devleti

The country in which a vessel is registered and whose laws, regulations, and international obligations the vessel must comply with, especially regarding safety and environmental standards.

Terimi gor

Birim Yük

A single item or assembly of goods, secured together so it can be handled as a single unit during storage and transportation.

Terimi gor

Boş Hacim

The unused space in a ship's hold or container that results from the irregular shape of cargo or inefficient packing.

Terimi gor

Boşaltma Tutanağı

A document verifying the unloading of goods from a container, indicating the cargo status, seal check, and any discrepancies or damages.

Terimi gor

Bunker Ayarlaması

A surcharge applied by carriers to account for fluctuations in marine fuel (bunker) prices.

Terimi gor

Charterparty Sözleşmesi

A formal contract between a shipowner and a charterer specifying terms for the hire and use of a vessel, including freight, laytime, demurrage, and responsibilities.

Terimi gor

Crossdock Operasyonu

A logistics process where incoming goods are unloaded and directly reloaded onto outbound vehicles with minimal or no storage time in between.

Terimi gor

Crossdock Operasyonu

The logistics practice of directly transferring goods from inbound to outbound vehicles, reducing or eliminating storage time.

Terimi gor

Dahilde İşleme

A customs procedure allowing imported goods to be processed and re-exported with suspension of import duties and taxes.

Terimi gor

Dara Ağırlığı

The weight of an empty container, vehicle, or packaging material, excluding the weight of its contents or cargo, as specified in transport and customs documentation. Used to determine net and gross weight in shipping, warehousing, and compliance.

Terimi gor

Deadweight Tonaj

The maximum weight a vessel can safely carry, including cargo, fuel, crew, supplies, and provisions, measured in metric tons (DWT).

Terimi gor

Demuraj Ücreti

A fee levied by carrier or terminal for detention of container or cargo beyond the free time allowed.

Terimi gor

Deniz Yük Senedi

A non-negotiable transport document evidencing carriage by sea without title transfer, issued by carrier.

Terimi gor

Depo Makbuzu

A legal document issued by a warehouse operator confirming receipt and storage of specified goods. Serves as evidence of title, storage, and may be negotiable for trade finance or collateral.

Terimi gor

Despatch Ücreti

A financial incentive paid by the shipowner to the charterer if loading/unloading is completed faster than the time allowed (laytime) in the charter party.

Terimi gor

Detention Ücreti

A fee charged by the carrier for use of containers or equipment outside the terminal or depot beyond the free time allowed for pick-up or return.

Terimi gor

Draft Ölçümü

A method of determining the weight of bulk cargo loaded or discharged from a vessel by measuring changes in the vessel’s draught before and after loading, in accordance with maritime standards.

Terimi gor

Dunnage Malzemesi

Materials used to protect, brace, and separate cargo during transportation, such as wood, inflatable bags, or foam, preventing movement, moisture, and damage.

Terimi gor

Dökme Yük Gemisi

A merchant vessel designed to transport unpackaged bulk cargo, such as grains, coal, ore, or cement, in its cargo holds. Classified by IMO for dry bulk shipping.

Terimi gor

Emniyetli Rıhtım

A mooring location or dock within a port that is free from navigational hazards, suitable for a vessel’s size, and provides safe loading, unloading, and shelter from risks.

Terimi gor

Faturalandırılabilir Ağırlık

The weight used by carriers to calculate freight charges, usually the greater of actual or volumetric (dimensional) weight, per tariff rules.

Terimi gor

Fazla Taşıma Riski

The possibility that cargo is not discharged at its intended port and is instead transported beyond its destination, leading to additional costs, delays, or claims.

Terimi gor

Feeder Servisi

A short-sea or coastal shipping service that transfers cargo between smaller regional ports and larger hub ports.

Terimi gor

Fitosaniter Kontrol

The mandatory inspection and certification procedures required by national or international plant protection authorities to prevent the introduction and spread of pests or diseases via traded agricultural commodities or packaging.

Terimi gor

Flexitank Yüklemesi

The process of filling a flexitank—a flexible bulk liquid container—inside a standard dry container for the transport of non-hazardous liquids, such as edible oils or wines.

Terimi gor

Gemi Programı

A published timetable showing the planned arrival and departure times of vessels at specific ports.

Terimi gor

Gemiyle Teslim Maliyeti

Total cost of a product once it has arrived at buyer’s doorstep, including purchase price, freight, insurance, duties, taxes, and handling fees.

Terimi gor

Gross Tonaj

The total internal volume of a vessel measured in tons, as defined by the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships (1969), used for registration, port fees, and safety regulations.

Terimi gor

Gümrük Müşaviri

A licensed agent authorised to prepare import/export entries, handle duties, and ensure regulatory compliance on behalf of importer/exporter.

Terimi gor

Gümrük Tarife Kodu

A standardized numerical code used to classify traded goods for customs purposes, based on the Harmonized System (HS) managed by the World Customs Organization.

Terimi gor

Güvenlik Beyanı

An advance electronic submission of shipment and cargo information to customs or border authorities for security screening prior to vessel loading or entry.

Terimi gor

Hariçte İşleme

A customs procedure allowing domestic goods to be temporarily exported for processing or repair abroad and then re-imported, usually with duty relief.

Terimi gor

Hat Taşımacılığı

Scheduled ocean transport service provided by shipping lines with fixed routes, regular timetables, and published tariffs for containerized or general cargo.

Terimi gor

Hinterland Teslimatı

Transport of goods from a port, airport, or border to inland destinations, often covering the final leg of international trade.

Terimi gor

House Bill

A Bill of Lading issued by a freight forwarder to a shipper, covering cargo consolidated in a master consignment.

Terimi gor

Incoterms Kuralı

A standard international commercial term, defined by the ICC, governing the allocation of risks, costs, and responsibilities between buyer and seller in trade.

Terimi gor

İhracat İzni

An official authorization issued by a government agency allowing the export of certain controlled or regulated goods, subject to compliance with export regulations.

Terimi gor

İskele İşlemleri

The process of loading or unloading cargo at a pier or dock, involving material handling equipment, stevedores, and compliance with port operational standards.

Terimi gor

İskele Rıhtımı

A designated location alongside a jetty—a structure projecting into water—where a vessel is moored for loading or unloading cargo or passengers at a port.

Terimi gor

İthalat İzni

An official authorization issued by a government agency allowing the importation of certain goods, subject to regulatory compliance.

Terimi gor

İç Taşıma

The transportation of goods between an inland location and a port or terminal by road, rail, or barge, as part of a multimodal logistics chain before or after the main ocean or air leg.

Terimi gor

İşyerinde Teslim

An Incoterm indicating that the seller makes the goods available at their premises, and the buyer bears all costs and risks involved in transporting the goods to the destination.

Terimi gor

Kabotaj Kısıtlaması

A legal limitation or prohibition imposed by a country on the transport of goods or passengers between domestic ports by foreign-flagged vessels or carriers.

Terimi gor

Kanal Su Derinliği

The maximum depth of water that ships can safely navigate within a specific channel, affecting vessel size and cargo load limits for port entry.

Terimi gor

Kara Rotası

A transport route that crosses land (by truck or rail), used for freight moving between inland points or to avoid sea/air legs.

Terimi gor

Karantina Denetimi

A regulatory examination of cargo, vessel, or crew by authorities to prevent the introduction and spread of pests, diseases, or contaminants at borders and ports.

Terimi gor

Konsolidasyon Servisi

A freight service that combines multiple shipments from different shippers into a single container or truckload to optimize costs and logistics.

Terimi gor

Köprü Altı Yüksekliği

The vertical distance from the waterline or road surface to the lowest part of a bridge, restricting the maximum height of vessels, vehicles, or cargo passing beneath.

Terimi gor

Kılavuzluk Hizmeti

A compulsory port or channel navigation service provided by licensed marine pilots to guide vessels safely into, within, or out of ports and through hazardous waters.

Terimi gor

Lashing Hesaplaması

The technical assessment of the type, quantity, and placement of securing materials (lashings) needed to stabilize cargo inside a container or on a vessel, ensuring compliance with safety standards.

Terimi gor

Laycan Dönemi

The agreed window of dates between shipowner and charterer during which a vessel must arrive at the loading port and be ready to load. If the vessel arrives before or after this period, contractual penalties or cancellation rights may apply.

Terimi gor

Laytime Hesaplaması

The computation of the total time allowed for loading and discharging a vessel as agreed in the charter party, with contractual consequences for exceeding or saving time (demurrage or dispatch).

Terimi gor

Liman Devleti Kontrolü

An inspection regime by national maritime authorities at ports to verify that foreign ships comply with international safety, security, and environmental standards (SOLAS, MARPOL, ISPS, MLC).

Terimi gor

Liner Koşulları

Standard contract terms for ocean freight shipments specifying that loading and discharging costs at the port are included in the carrier’s freight rate, under regular scheduled service.

Terimi gor

Manifesto Düzeltmesi

An official alteration or correction to the details in a cargo manifest, made to reflect changes in cargo, consignee, or other shipment data before customs clearance.

Terimi gor

Master Bill

A Bill of Lading issued by the carrier to the freight forwarder, covering entire cargo under one shipment.

Terimi gor

Mate Makbuzu

A document signed by the chief officer (mate) of a vessel acknowledging the receipt and apparent order of goods loaded on board, often used to issue the bill of lading.

Terimi gor

Menşe Şahadetnamesi

An official document confirming the country of origin of goods, used for customs clearance and trade compliance.

Terimi gor

Navlun Ödenmiş

A shipping instruction indicating that the seller has paid freight charges to carrier, but risk transfers per agreed Incoterm.

Terimi gor

Net Tonaj

The volume of a ship’s cargo spaces, measured in tons according to the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships (1969), used to determine port fees and canal tolls.

Terimi gor

Outturn Raporu

An official document recording the quantity and condition of goods discharged from a vessel or container at the port of arrival, used for claims, insurance, and operational performance tracking.

Terimi gor

Paketleme Listesi

A detailed document prepared by the exporter or shipper, listing each item, quantity, and packaging details in a shipment. Essential for customs clearance, insurance, and logistics planning.

Terimi gor

Palet Takası

A logistics practice where shippers and consignees swap pallets at the point of delivery to avoid loss and maintain pallet pool balances.

Terimi gor

Rampa İşlemleri

The operational process of loading or unloading vehicles, containers, or cargo using a ramp at a terminal, port, or warehouse, often involving Ro-Ro vessels or trailers.

Terimi gor

Riskin Devri

The contractual point at which responsibility for cargo risk passes from seller to buyer, defined by Incoterms.

Terimi gor

Rıhtım Tahsisi

The formal assignment or request for a specific berth at a port, usually made by the vessel’s agent or shipping line, required for scheduling arrival, mooring, and cargo operations.

Terimi gor

Rıhtım Vinci

A large crane located on a port quay, used for loading and unloading containers or cargo from vessels to the dock, essential in container terminal operations.

Terimi gor

Rıhtım Ücreti

A fee charged by port authorities for the use of wharf or quay facilities during the loading or unloading of cargo.

Terimi gor

Rıhtım Ücreti

A port charge levied for the use of wharf or quay facilities in the loading or unloading of cargo, commonly included in port tariffs and paid by shipowners, agents, or cargo owners.

Terimi gor

Sağlık Sertifikası

An official document issued by health authorities certifying that products, especially foodstuffs or animals, comply with sanitary regulations for export or import.

Terimi gor

Sefer Aralığı

A specific period during which a vessel is scheduled to depart from a port, allowing shippers to plan cargo delivery accordingly.

Terimi gor

Seferlik Çarter

A shipping contract where a vessel is hired for a single voyage between specified ports, with payment based on cargo quantity or lumpsum.

Terimi gor

Slot Kiralama

An agreement by which a shipping line or operator charters a specified number of container slots on a vessel operated by another carrier, allowing flexible space allocation without full vessel charter.

Terimi gor

Son Taşıma Ayağı

The final stage of a multimodal or through transport chain, moving cargo from the main arrival terminal to the consignee’s premises.

Terimi gor

Soğutuculu Konteyner

A refrigerated shipping container designed for the transport of perishable goods under controlled temperature, commonly used for food, pharmaceuticals, and chemicals in global trade.

Terimi gor

Stevedoring Sözleşmesi

A formal agreement between a shipping company or terminal operator and a stevedoring firm for the loading, unloading, and handling of cargo at a port.

Terimi gor

Taşıyıcı Taşımacılığı

Transport of containers by the shipping line’s own contracted inland carrier, covering inland moves under the ocean bill of lading.

Terimi gor

Taşıyıcıya Teslim

An Incoterm where the seller delivers the goods, cleared for export, to the carrier nominated by the buyer at the named place.

Terimi gor

Tehlikeli Madde

Substances or articles classified by UN Model Regulations as posing risks to health, safety, property, or environment during transport.

Terimi gor

Tehlikeli Madde Ek Ücreti

An extra charge applied by carriers or terminals for the handling, transport, or storage of dangerous or hazardous goods as defined by regulations.

Terimi gor

Tek Taşıma Senedi

A single transport document covering the movement of goods across multiple carriers and modes from origin to final destination, simplifying transshipment and customs procedures.

Terimi gor

Tercihli Menşe Şahadetnamesi

A formal document certifying that goods qualify for preferential tariff treatment under specific trade agreements, typically issued by a competent authority.

Terimi gor

Terminal Elleçleme

A charge levied by terminal operators for the movement, storage, and handling of containers at the port or terminal.

Terimi gor

Teslim Emri

A document issued by carrier or agent instructing terminal or warehouse to release cargo to the consignee or their agent.

Terimi gor

Transit Beyannamesi

A formal customs document used to declare goods in transit across international borders, ensuring duties and security compliance during movement.

Terimi gor

Vanning Sertifikası

An official document issued by a surveyor or authority certifying that cargo has been properly stuffed, secured, and inspected inside a container prior to shipment.

Terimi gor

Varış Bildirimi

A formal notice sent by carrier or agent to consignee informing them that cargo or vessel has arrived at destination.

Terimi gor

Vergi İadesi

A refund of customs duties, taxes, and fees paid on imported materials that are subsequently exported or used in the manufacture of exported goods, as authorized by customs regulations.

Terimi gor

Yerleştirme Planı

A detailed plan showing the placement of cargo on board a vessel to ensure safe, efficient, and balanced loading.

Terimi gor

Yük Manifestosu

A detailed list of all cargo on board, required by customs and port authorities for clearance and security controls.

Terimi gor

Yükleme Limanı

The designated port where cargo is loaded onto a vessel or means of transport for export or onward shipment.

Terimi gor

Yükleme Tutanağı

An official document confirming the loading of cargo into a shipping container, including details of cargo, seal, time, and loading supervision.

Terimi gor

Yükleten Taşımacılığı

Inland transport of containers arranged and contracted by the merchant (shipper/consignee), not the shipping line.

Terimi gor

Çoklu Taşıma

A transport operation involving at least two different modes of carriage (e.g., sea, road, rail, air) under a single contract and responsibility.

Terimi gor

Çoklu Taşıma

A freight movement under a single contract involving at least two different transport modes (e.g., sea, rail, truck, air), typically with one responsible carrier.

Terimi gor

Ön Taşıma Ayağı

The initial stage of transport that moves cargo from the shipper’s premises to the main point of international departure, typically by inland or feeder transport under multimodal contracts.
